checked.label: identity: slipped again
problems: 'Half the quit attempts ran 36 days or more' misreads the source: 36.5 days is the median total duration per journal, and it clashes with the same paper's Table 2, where 52 in 100 journals recorded 7-30 days. A line resting on the paper's internal conflict is not safe.
Use Table 2 instead: 22 + 13 + 15 = 50 of 104 journals recorded more than a month (about 48 in 100). Also drops 'half', close to the 50 in 100 card.

fix.beliefs[4].proof: In men’s porn-quit journals, most by men who called themselves addicted, about 48 in 100 recorded a quit attempt of over a month, though many wrote of a slip along the way.
